source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance, auto_adjust=True (dividend- and split-adjusted close)

download_metadata.note: The snapshot pre-dates this pipeline: it was first committed to git in the Person 3 foundation commit (6d18d37, 2026-10-26) without retrieval metadata. Its date range, columns and SHA-256 are recorded here; the download time and yfinance version are not.

reproducibility_warning: Adjusted prices are re-scaled after every dividend, so a later download will not match this snapshot exactly. The committed snapshot is canonical.
